newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse sets price moves on Finance One stock.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse sets price moves on Finance One stock.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand on Thursday set minimum and maximum price limits for the shares and warrants of cashed-strapped Finance One Plc when they resume trading after a long suspension on Friday.
Finance One shares could be traded up to a ceiling price of no more than 47.50 baht and a floor of no less than 0.10 baht, the bourse said in a statement.
Its warrants could be traded to a maximum price of 88 baht and a minimum of 0.10 baht, it added.

Market players said they were cautiously awaiting the resumption of Finance One stocks trading because a sell-off in the ailing company's securities was expected and the whole market could be dragged down with it on Friday.
The exchange also cautioned all investors to "exercise careful consideration" when trading Finance One securities.
Finance One stocks were suspended in early March following news of its proposed merger with Thai Danu Bank Plc.
The merger collapsed last week when the two institutions mutually agreed to call it off, citing tax and legal complications.
Finance One shares closed at 23.75 baht on February 28, the last day when it was traded before its suspension.
